notes: CardDemo's Db2 transaction-type maintenance (COBTUPDT, MNTTRDB2 under DSN) on GENERATED rows and input (#4507), proving the carddemo-cobtupdt port on data it was not written against: 14 CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE rows built from TRNTYPE.ddl (CHAR(2) key at full length, blank and in between; VARCHAR(50) description empty, at its maximum, with trailing blanks), and 40 INPFILE records laid out by the program's own FD: the type cycling add / update / delete / comment / invalid, the number drawn from the generated keys (an add of one the table holds: SQLCODE -803; an update or delete of one it does not: +100) with a share (35%) it does not hold. Every statement's SQLCODE, SQLSTATE and row count is compared with what Db2 answered (compare_sql), and the table after the step, column by column.
